question: Who among the following is a celebrated sarod maestro?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zarin Sharma.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Zarin Sharma**, also known as Zarine Sharma (née Daruwalla), is a celebrated sarod maestro. She was born on **October 9, 1946****.**
 
• She started learning the harmonium at the age of four and fell in love with the sarod </s
